correctness.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified as genuine sub-goal package of admitted target (same pair {F7,K4^(3)}, same flag-plus-symmetrization method, lower-bound + preservation + small-order arms; not a substitute). All three headline components verified true with proof vs computation distinguished. (1) Template theorem: independently re-enumerated all 3^7 Fano and 3^4 K4 part-maps into multisets {012,001,112,022} — 0 good in both cases (matches t1_certificate.json); edge formula n0*n1*n2+C(n0,2)*n1+C(n1,2)*n2+C(n2,2)*n0 verified, balanced n=3q gives (5q^3-3q^2)/2 over C(3q,3) -> 5/9 exactly (e.g. (3,2,2)->23, (3,3,3)->54); hence pi>=5/9 proved. Blow-up containment logic (copy iff part-map sends every edge into template) is sound. (2) Cloning preservation: proof logic M1/M2/M3 + case split verified sound. M1 (no {u,v} edge) holds by construction; M2 pair-coverage independently verified 21/21 for Fano (each pair exactly once, STS(7)) and 6/6 for K4, so copy holds at most one of u,v; M3 u|->v replacement is injective and sends H'-edges to H-edges, so copy transfers. Generic but correct. Supporting 210 labelings/35 4-sets and exhaustive n=6 K4 check are consistent. (3) ex(7)=23: lower bound Turan (3,2,2)=23 verified F-free by template check; upper bound <=23 independently re-proved by auditor via hitting-set search (35 vars, 65 constraints = 35 K4-quads + 30 Fano copies; verified 30 distinct Fano copies = 7!/168): no hitting set of size <=11 (i.e. no >=24-edge F-free graph), UNSAT in 1.6s/1.55M nodes. Submitted t4_ex7.json alone is assertion-only (OPTIMAL flag, 40.1M nodes, no replay script/log) so not independently replayable as submitted, but mathematical claim is true via auditor re-proof. Supporting 477965 labeled K4-free on 6 vertices re-enumerated exactly (2^20 check, 0.55s). Order<=6 blindness lemma (F7 needs 7 vertices, so pair-free=K4-free) is sound. n=8,9,10 shape search (36/54/75 vs 34/49/69) and 13080-step cloning spot-check correctly labeled heuristic/spot-check, not optimality. Asymptotic 5/9 upper bound and stability honestly stated as NOT proved; preset <=0.56 certificate honestly stated as NOT delivered.

Fused 20 results, coverage SerpBase ok, OpenAlex ok (0 hits), Crossref ok (15 each, all graph-K4 noise), partial=false. No prior states the package. Nearest priors inspected in full (Baber-Talbot arXiv:1110.4287v3 HTML fetched; Keevash-Sudakov, Razborov, Falgas-Ravry/Vaughan via admission full-text + snippets): Fano-alone pi=3/4, K4-alone conjectured 5/9 ceiling 0.561666, induced {K4,E1} 5/9, Baber-Talbot pi(K4,Hi)=5/9 for ten 6-vertex Hi (max vertex 6 in every Hi definition, e.g. H1 12 edges on 6 vertices), H-densities pi_{K4-}(K4)=16/27 — none equals 7-vertex 7-edge Fano and none gives pi({F7,K4}), ex(7,{F7,K4}), or all-n template/preservation for this pair. Component (ii) in isolation is a direct instance of the standard covering-family Zykov principle, but the full package (finite 3^7/3^4 verification + certified ex7=23) is not recorded or mechanically implied. See decisive_checks for adversarial checklist.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING judged under ordinary full value standard with no preset presumption (fallback <=0.56 NOT completed, so no Admission conditional approval; no ADMISSION_DEFECT alleged). Package leaves admitted frontier interval [5/9,0.561666] entirely unchanged: no upper-bound inequality, no slack, no narrowing, no stability classification. (i) pi>=5/9 is verification that the classical 1941 Turan construction Tn (known K4-free, known density 5/9) is also Fano-free via 2187-case check — a routine finite check on a known object, recomputable in milliseconds, not a new construction or benchmark step. (ii) cloning preservation for two covering hypergraphs is the textbook covering-family symmetrization corollary (5-line proof), enables symmetrization but by the report's own admission yields no numeric ceiling alone and excludes no extremal shape. (iii) ex(7)=23 is one isolated small-n exact number at the Fano order, explained only as equals-Turan, with n=8 B&B TIMEOUT (51.1M nodes, incumbent 36 unproved) and n=8-10 heuristic-only, i.e. an incomplete census honestly described but with no general criterion, no completed census, and no demonstrated downstream use; recomputable in ~1.6s, cheaper to recompute than retrieve. Collectively this is a textbook baseline verification + generic lemma + single tiny enumeration without substantive density advance, falling under textbook restatement / unexplained-enumeration / missing-substantive-result even though correct and new. The narrow-datum carve-out does not rescue it because the datum's future-retrieval need is not shown beyond serving as scaffold for the still-blocked 5/9 retry, and certification alone does not rescue it. Intrinsic low value / missing substantive result => REJECT, not repairable by bounded literature/motivation addition (rescue would require a new density ceiling, i.e. a new research direction).
